transcript_id.description: Echo exactly the id given in the prompt.

statement_date_doubt.description: One answer for the whole transcript. See VERIFICATION.md section 1 and ELIGIBILITY.md: recording_older_than_stated holds every record of the transcript until the recording is dated. A doubt written only in notes is read by nothing.

evidence.description: The words from the title, description or transcript that show the recording is older, copied. Null when doubt is none.

evidence_year.description: The year the evidence names, or null.

qualifies.description: attribution == subject and every gate true and claim_faithful.

resolution_criteria.description: In your own words, without reference to the extractor's. By <date or dated event>, <observable> <outcome>; for a figure for a period, For <period> (ending <date>), <figure> will be <outcome>, as reported at any time, never 'By <period end>, X will report'. State ONE direction, never the form 'will / will not'. Write it so that TRUE means the speaker was RIGHT: keep the speaker's own negation rather than flipping it. See ELIGIBILITY.md G2.
